review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer ( Swimming Pool )
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Sales Engineer – Swimming Pools Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience Industry: Swimming Pools / Water Features / Construction / MEP Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Sales Engineer – Swimming Pools with a minimum of 3 years of proven experience in the swimming pool industry . The successful candidate will be responsible for developing sales opportunities, understanding customer requirements, preparing technical and commercial proposals, conducting site visits, and providing technical solutions for swimming pool projects. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of swimming pool systems, equipment, materials, installation requirements, and related MEP works, combined with excellent sales and negotiation skills. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities within the swimming pool and construction sectors. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, developers, and project owners. Visit project sites to assess requirements, take measurements, and understand technical conditions. Review swimming pool drawings, specifications, BOQs, and project requirements. Prepare accurate technical and commercial quotations based on customer requirements. Recommend suitable swimming pool equipment, systems, and materials according to project specifications and budget. Provide technical presentations and explain proposed solutions to customers and consultants. Coordinate with the Engineering, Procurement, Estimation, and Project teams to ensure accurate proposals and smooth project execution. Follow up on submitted quotations and negotiate prices, terms, and commercial conditions. Prepare and submit technical submittals, product data sheets, and material specifications when required. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and new swimming pool technologies. Maintain an updated sales pipeline and provide regular sales forecasts and reports. Follow up with customers from initial inquiry through quotation, negotiation, order confirmation, and project handover. Attend client meetings, technical meetings, and site meetings as required. Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to the company's overall revenue growth. Ensure excellent customer service and maintain long-term business relationships. Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and technical issues professionally. Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain technical information, prices, availability, and delivery schedules. Technical Knowledge The candidate should have good knowledge of: Swimming pool design and construction requirements. Swimming pool filtration and circulation systems. Pumps, filters, heaters, dosing systems, and control systems. Swimming pool water treatment and chemical dosing systems. Skimmers, main drains, return inlets, and pool fittings. PVC/UPVC piping and hydraulic systems. Pool lighting and electrical requirements. Overflow and skimmer pool systems. Water features, fountains, waterfalls, and related systems. Swimming pool accessories and equipment. Reading and interpreting technical drawings and BOQs. Basic hydraulic and MEP calculations. Swimming pool installation methods and site requirements. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering , or a related field. Minimum 3 years of relevant sales engineering experience in the swimming pool industry . Proven experience in selling swimming pool equipment, systems, materials, or related construction solutions. Strong technical understanding of swimming pool systems. Experience dealing with contractors, consultants, developers, and end customers. Valid driving license is preferred. Good command of English , both written and spoken. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Knowledge of AutoCAD is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
review_candidates.description: Company Description Central Consulting Company is a consulting and technology firm with over 9 years of experience in developing and managing projects funded by European and national programs. The company provides comprehensive services covering the entire project lifecycle — from strategic planning and pre-project analysis to successful funding acquisition and project implementation. In recent years, the company has expanded its focus into the technology sector and is currently developing a large-scale AI-driven software platform designed to support businesses through automation, data analysis, and intelligent decision-making. Our goal is to build scalable digital systems that help organizations improve efficiency, optimize processes, and make data-driven strategic decisions. Role Description We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Team Lead to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will lead a team of developers and play a key role in the development of a complex AI-driven software platform that integrates multiple modules for business process management, data analytics, and automation. You will be responsible for coordinating the development process, ensuring high engineering standards, and translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions. The role combines technical leadership and hands-on development, requiring strong engineering expertise as well as the ability to guide and mentor developers. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate a team of software developers working on a complex AI-driven platform. Translate business requirements and architectural concepts into clear technical tasks. Ensure high code quality through code reviews, development standards, and best practices. Collaborate closely with the software architect and product stakeholders. Guide the team in solving technical challenges and making sound engineering decisions. Support the planning and execution of development sprints. Participate in designing scalable and maintainable backend systems. Qualifications Minimum 5 years of experience in software development. Experience leading or mentoring software development teams. Strong backend development experience with Python. Experience building and integrating REST APIs and web applications. Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and modern software design patterns. Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development methodologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Nice to Have Experience with an additional programming language is considered a strong advantage. Experience with AI/ML systems. Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or similar). Experience with microservices architecture. Experience with automation or digital transformation platforms. Why Join Us Opportunity to work on a large-scale AI-driven software platform. A key leadership role in shaping the development process and architecture. Collaboration with experienced professionals in technology, consulting, and business strategy. A dynamic environment focused on innovation and long-term development.
